# docx fixtures

Real files the docx reader's tests read, each small and redistributable under the license named, committed unmodified unless the line says otherwise. No GPL file and no upload to a project's bug tracker.

|---|---|---|
| `docx4j-loadAndSave.docx` | https://github.com/plutext/docx4j/blob/VERSION_17_2_1/docx4j-core-tests/src/test/resources/loadAndSave.docx | Apache-2.0 |
| `govuk-Application_for_Approval_as_a_Community_Sponsor.docx` | https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/6981e416015e2ba11991bb71/Application_for_Approval_as_a_Community_Sponsor.docx (page https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/apply-for-full-community-sponsorship) | OGL-3.0 |
| `lo-ooxmlexport-tdf126287.docx` | https://github.com/LibreOffice/core/blob/master/sw/qa/extras/ooxmlexport/data/tdf126287.docx | MPL-2.0 |
| `lo-ooxmlimport-tdf136952_pgBreak3.docx` | https://github.com/LibreOffice/core/blob/master/sw/qa/extras/ooxmlimport/data/tdf136952_pgBreak3.docx | MPL-2.0 |
